Lemma
[The Tail of an Orthonormal Basis Spans the Complement of its Head]

↗ lem:orthogonal-complement

For an orthonormal basis $(b_1,\ldots ,b_n)$ of a finite-dimensional nondegenerate space, \[ \operatorname {span}(b_2,\ldots ,b_n)=\operatorname {span}(b_1)^\perp . \]
Proof

↗ lem:orthogonal-complement \sketch Orthogonality gives inclusion. Both sides have dimension $n-1$, the second by Lemma 3, so equality follows.

□
